description: Monthly teaching data for simple and multiple OLS regression.
base_observation: December 2010 is included only to calculate the first monthly Brent change.

energy_portfolio.selection: Enrgy from Average Value Weighted Returns -- Monthly; source percentages divided by 100.

market_and_risk_free.selection: Mkt-RF and RF from the monthly block; source percentages divided by 100.

brent.selection: Last available DCOILBRENTEU observation in each calendar month from the existing daily extract.

columns.date: Calendar month-end label; not necessarily the date of the Brent observation.
columns.Energy: Monthly simple total return on the value-weighted US energy industry portfolio, decimal.
columns.Market_excess: Monthly US market return minus the matched monthly risk-free return, decimal.
columns.RF: Monthly risk-free return, decimal; not an annualised yield.
columns.Brent_spot: Last observed Brent spot price in the month, USD per barrel.
columns.Brent_observation_date: Date of the daily price used for Brent_spot.

transformations.Energy: 100 * (Energy - RF) in the notebook: energy excess return in percent.
transformations.Market: 100 * Market_excess in the notebook: market excess return in percent.
transformations.Brent: 100 * (Brent_spot_t / Brent_spot_(t-1) - 1): monthly spot-price change in percent; not a futures investment return.
transformations.sample: Both regressions use the same 180 monthly observations; no forward filling.
